topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't stop pacing, the lines of my artwork staring back at me from the stranger's skin. How did it come to this? My creations, meant for paper, galleries, a gaze that loves and admires – now permanent, altered, on this person who doesn't understand the heart I poured into each stroke. I feel the walls closing in, the air thin. My work, my soul, twisted and taken, and I can’t find the breath to scream. What right do they have? What can I do to fix this, to make it go away?
